regions.text: 要するにこの種の偶然性は、離接可能性の一離接肢が現實として眼前に措定された場合にその現實が可能性全體に對して従つてまた不可能性に對して、有つところの醐係である。

quote.translation: Contingency of this kind, in short, is the relation that the actual has to possibility as a whole, and accordingly to impossibility as well, when one disjunct of disjunctive possibility has been posited before our eyes as the actual.

regions.text: さうして離接的可能性が不可能性の反勤を押し切つて、現實性へすべつてくる推移のスピードに、偶然の遊戲の流線型が感獨されるのである。

quote.translation: And in the speed of the transition by which disjunctive possibility, pushing through the opposition of impossibility, slides into actuality, we feel the streamlined form of the play of chance.

regions.text: 様相任の論理が時間性と深い開係を有つてゐることはオスカ！ベッカーも注意してゐるが（OskarB

quote.translation: Oskar Becker has also noted that the logic of Modality stands in a deep relation to temporality (Oskar Becker, Jahrbuch f. Philos.
u. phän. F. XI, S. 539), and for us it is of particular importance to elucidate the temporal character of contingency.

regions.text: ては偶然性の時間性格を閑明することが特に重要な意義を有つてるる。偶然の時間的限定、特に假説的偶然の同時性および機起性に就ては襲に述べた（第二章第一七節参照）。

quote.translation: I have already discussed the temporal delimitation of the contingent, and in particular the simultaneity and successiveness of hypothetical contingency (see Chapter 2, section 17).

regions.text: しかしいつたい偶然は他の諸様相に對して時間約地平において如何なる特殊の性格を有つてゐるか。

quote.translation: But what special character, in general, does the contingent possess on the temporal horizon, over against the other modalities?

regions.text: 時間の地平において他の諸様相と個然性との開係を

quote.translation: By considering the relation between contingency and the other modalities on the horizon of time, we can make the structure of contingency clearer still.
